title: Electric Heating of Mass
description: Calculator for determining temperature rise in an electric heated object or mass. Uses the principle that electric energy supplied equals thermal energy change: P·t·μ = c·m·dT. Heat loss during heating is neglected in this calculation.

components.content:
# Electric Heating of Mass

When an electric heater heats an object, the electric energy is transformed to heat by increased object temperature.

**Formula:** dT = U·I·t·μ / (c·m)

Where:
- **P** = power (watts, W)
- **U** = potential difference (volts, V)
- **I** = electrical current (amps, A)
- **t** = time (seconds)
- **μ** = heating efficiency (0-1)
- **c** = specific heat of substance (J/kg°C)
- **m** = mass of substance (kg)
- **dT** = temperature difference (°C)

**Note:** The mass of the heater and heat loss during heating are neglected in this calculation.
